title: Simplicial enriched Yoneda evaluation
statement:
Use simplicial sets and Kan complexes of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and simplicial categories, enriched functors, mapping ends, projective simplicial model structures, and cofibrant-fibrant objects from [lem-coef-simplicial-presheaf-projective-model] and [lem-coef-simplicial-projective-model-calculus]. A simplicial functor preserves the identity vertices and simplicial composition; an enriched natural transformation is a family of vertex components satisfying the naturality equality on every mapping simplicial set.

Let $A$ be a small locally Kan simplicial category and let $\mathsf M=\operatorname{Fun}_{\Delta}(A^{\mathrm{op}},\mathrm{sSet})$ have its projective simplicial model structure.  For $a\in A$, put $Y_a=A(-,a)$.  For every projectively cofibrant-fibrant diagram $P$, restriction at the enriched identity defines a simplicial isomorphism
\[
\varepsilon_{a,P}:\underline{\operatorname{Map}}_{\mathsf M}(Y_a,P)\xrightarrow{\;\cong\;}P(a),
\qquad
\alpha\longmapsto\alpha_a(1_a).
\]
Its inverse sends a simplex $p$ of $P(a)$ to the enriched transformation $f\mapsto P(f)(p)$.  These maps are natural in $a$ and $P$ on the full simplicial mapping complexes, preserve all faces and degeneracies, and satisfy the enriched composition and unit equalities.

source.place: Explicit strict enriched Yoneda construction for simplicial categories, as used with the projective model of HTT Appendix A.3.3 in HTT Section 5.1.3; not a verbatim theorem of HTT.
